_about: Public-domain Walter F. Adeney (1849-1920), Congregational scholar, professor at New College, London, and Principal of Lancashire Independent College, for the Word Hoard: The Hebrew Utopia (1879), his Expositor's Bible volumes on Ezra, Nehemiah and Esther and on the Song of Solomon and Lamentations, The Theology of the New Testament (1894), How to Read the Bible, The Construction of the Bible, Women of the New Testament, his Century Bible volumes on St. Luke and on Thessalonians and Galatians, The New Testament Story Retold for Young People, The Greek and Eastern Churches (1908), and, with W. H. Bennett, A Biblical Introduction (1899). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 70 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

adeney-hebrew-utopia: The Hebrew utopia : a study of messianic prophecy (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1879)

adeney-women-of-nt: Women of the New Testament (London : Service & Paton, 1899)

adeney-st-luke: St. Luke, The Century Bible (New York: H. Frowde, catalogued 1906)
adeney-thessalonians-galatians: Thessalonians and Galatians, The Century Bible (New York: H. Frowde, catalogued 1906)
